ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DESC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure will take a mode parameter and select following
** information from the database
** 1. associated letter code and letter title.
** 2. user name
*/
FUNCTION get_desc (p_mode varchar2, p_code varchar2) return varchar2 is
 szCode varchar2(10);
 szDesc varchar2(100);
 szFName varchar2(50);
 szLName varchar2(50);
 szMI varchar2(50);

 cursor cur_lett (p_code varchar2) is
 select letter_title
 from valid_letters 
 where letter_code = p_code;

 cursor cur_user (p_code varchar2) is
 select user_first_name, user_last_name, user_initials
 from system_users
 where user_id = p_code
 and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id;

BEGIN
 if p_mode = 'LETTER' then
 open cur_lett(p_code);
 fetch cur_lett 
 into szDesc;
 if cur_lett%NOTFOUND then
 szDesc := 'N/A';
 end if;
 if cur_lett%ISOPEN then
 close cur_lett;
 end if;
 elsif p_mode = 'NAME' then
 open cur_user(p_code);
 fetch cur_user 
 into szFName, szLName, szMI;
 if cur_user%NOTFOUND then
 szDesc := 'N/A';
 else
-- szDesc := upper(szlname || ', ' || szfname || ' ' || szMI);
 szDesc := upper(szlname || ', ' || szfname);
 end if;
 if cur_user%ISOPEN then
 close cur_user;
 end if;
 end if;

 RETURN szDesc;
exception
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REPRINT_LETTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE reprint_letter IS
 dtVerDate date;
 szStatus varchar2(100);
BEGIN
 clear_message;
 message('System is retrieving letter.......', no_acknowledge);
-- synchronize;

 /*
 ** Code to reprint letter
 */

 begin
 update donor_letters
 set last_reprinted_by = :parameter.p_insert_user,
 last_reprinted_on = sysdate
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 and letter_seq_no = :parameter.p_letter_seq_no;

 commit_form;

 exception
 when others then
 message ('Reprint records couldnot be generated.');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end;
 -- generate letter report/ file
 begin
 select version_date
 into dtVerDate
 from valid_letters
 where letter_code = :donor_letters.letter_code
 and version_no = (select max( a.version_no )
 from valid_letters a
 where a.letter_code = :donor_letters.letter_code );
 exception
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 run_letter_report ('DNRLETTR',
 :parameter.p_chapter_id,
 :parameter.p_donor_id,
 :parameter.p_letter_seq_no,
 :donor_letters.letter_code,
 to_char( dtVerDate, 'MM-DD-YY' ),
 szStatus );

 if szStatus != 'OK' then
 message( szStatus ); pause;
 end if;

 exit_form(no_validate);

END;

PROCEDURE RUN_LETTER_REPORT (p_report_name IN varchar2,

 p_donor_id IN varchar2,
 p_letter_seq_no IN varchar2,
 p_letter_code IN varchar2,
 p_ver_date IN varchar2,

 ) IS

 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 x varchar2(1);

 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 temp varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;
 v_rep VARCHAR2(100);
 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 
--for Apps server 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);
--url_val VARCHAR2(200) := NULL; --for ORA11g

 -- Multiple Reports Server feature
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(100);
 l_svr_url VARCHAR2(100);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 begin
 select 'x' 
 into x
 from donor_letter_text
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 and letter_seq_no = p_letter_seq_no;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 p_status := 'Letter not Generated';
 return;
 when others then
 p_status := substr(sqlerrm,1,100);
 return;
 end;
 /*
 ** Generate Parameter List
 */
 begin 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 p_status := 'Error creating parameter list '||pl_name;
 return;
 END IF; 
 end; 
 
 /* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
/* -- Commented on 04/11/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LTRepServer_Donor.pkg
 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into val 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
*/
 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 ------------ 

 /*
 ** ADD Parameters to the parameter list
 */
 filename:=p_report_name||'_'||p_donor_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(p_report_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,nvl(p_chapter_id,'WAD'));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_DONOR_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER, p_donor_id ) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_LETTER_SEQ_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, p_letter_seq_no ) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_LETTER_CODE',TEXT_PARAMETER, p_letter_code ) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_VER_DATE',TEXT_PARAMETER, p_ver_date ) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER, LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid) ; -- Added by Ashok on 11/04/2014 IM-9996 (traceback to IM 5758)
 
 ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
 vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 --message('Status='||vc_rep_status);

 WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
 LOOP
 vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 END LOOP;

 --message('number -3');

 If vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 -- Added on 04/11/2011; Ashok; Multiple Report Server feature added. 
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_url( in_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_server_url => l_svr_url,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(l_svr_url || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||l_svr_name,'_blank');
 ------------------------------
/* Commented on 04/11/2012; Below logic moved to LTREPSERVER_DONOR.PKG 
 ---added for Global changes ---
 url_val := get_rep_url_donor; 
 if url_val is null then
 show_error('9776');
 end if;
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(url_val || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
 ---
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
*/ 
 --message('Order Slip generated'); -- commented form IM 9996
 Else
 message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
 End if;
 
-- rp2rro.rp2rro_run_product(REPORTS,p_report_name,ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
-- run_product(REPORTS,rep_dir||p_report_name,ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
 p_status := 'OK';

END;
